newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin works on papers, meets Chubais.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin works on papers, meets Chubais.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin, recovering from pneumonia at a residence outside Moscow, met his chief of staff Anatoly Chubais on Friday, the Kremlin press service said.

A spokesman at the presidential press office said the 65-year-old president, who left hospital on Monday after 12 days treatment for pneumonia, was also working on papers, including preparing an annual address to the joint houses of parliament.
Interfax news agency said Yeltsin was likely to make the speech at the end of February.

Doctors say Yeltsin will need two or three weeks to convalesce from the pneumonia, although aides said the president visited the Kremlin on Wednesday to have talks with Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin.
Chernomyrdin said on Thursday he expected Yeltsin to return to full work soon.
The doctors say the latest illness is not linked to the heart problems which sidelined the president for most of the second half of last year. He underwent open heart surgery on November 5.
